name: Ura Shuukatsu ~Nandemo Shimasu Kara Irete Kudasai!
original_name: 裏就活～何でもシますから挿入れてください！
source:
As he was appointed by the head of the Human Resources Department, he absolutely had to hire a good employee.

"I must hire a good employee." With this in mind, he conducted the job interviews.

However, His heart was not in the right place for Ayumi Jumonji, who had a very confident attitude. He took advantage of his position as an interviewer, and attempted to commit lewd acts by using his position as an interviewer and power harassment.

Masahiko, who had a clue to capture Ayumi, extended his evil hand to Yuki Katakura, a weak-looking job-hunting girl.

How will this lust-driven job hunt end?

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/urasyukatsu/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
他是人力资源部部长任命的，所以肯定要招到一个好员工。

“我必须雇用一名好员工。”考虑到这一点，他进行了求职面试。

然而，对于态度非常自信的十文字步美来说，他的心却不在正确的地方。他利用采访者身份，企图利用采访者身份、权力骚扰等行为实施猥亵行为。

掌握了抓捕步美线索的正彦，将邪恶之手伸向了外表柔弱的求职女孩片仓由纪。

这场欲望驱动的求职之旅将如何结束？
